info.title: AccreMind Knowledge API
info.description: Implementation contract for PRD V2.1. Domain authorization and publication invariants require service validation beyond JSON Schema. Contract v2 is a pre-implementation breaking revision; see B20 and the v2 migration guide.

post.summary: Freeze minimum exact evidence before approval
post.description: Also requires exact source evidence read authorization. Copy an actual allowed source slice, never model-generated rationale; keep source scope, source_ref/version/locator and content hash. New retained identity is returned and must be rebound to assessment before approval. Idempotent operation_id. Unavailable source is unified 404.

201.description: New or idempotently recovered retained evidence

422.description: Locator or retention policy blocks capture

get.description: Read exactly the requested available evidence version after scope authorization; inaccessible, missing, quarantined, expired or deleted versions return unified 404.

post.description: Verify challenge and state then atomically consume approved ticket once. Lost successful response requires a new ticket/login, not a second token issuance.

Atomic consume-and-rotate using stored token hashes and family history. Reuse of consumed token revokes the family. Unknown token gets generic 401. No grace/replay cache: lost rotation response requires fresh browser login, never retry the old token.

get.description: Authorized management detail; does not replace budgeted MCP read. Per-principal rate/payload limits apply. Explicit historical revisions additionally require knowledge:history; withdrawn/archived/suspended body requires knowledge:review in the same scope and is historical_reference only.
Read exactly the requested available evidence version after scope authorization; inaccessible, missing, quarantined, expired or deleted versions return unified 404.

post.description: Web session only; CSRF token and exact allowed Origin required. Bind current OIDC subject to a server-eligible tenant. State hash and pending/unexpired ticket must match. Same operation replay requires original decision actor and payload; different decisions on a decided ticket return 409.

get.description: Authorized navigation only; recheck source access/state before returning title, locator or URL. Does not return advice, grow knowledge counts or bypass source permissions. Cursor binds actor/scope/filter.

expected_revision.description: Candidate revision. Revision candidates additionally require expected_target_revision equal to stored base_aggregate_revision.

current_publication.description: Current candidate revision's publication; enables refresh recovery without storing sensitive content or guessing IDs.

session_id.description: Tool session ID is also its refresh-token family ID; absolute family expiry is at most 7 days.

SearchHit.description: Budgeted search segment; revision is content revision. Not a complete detail.

KnowledgeDetail.description: Full versioned body; maturity/freshness belong to requested content revision, publication/serving and aggregate_revision are current aggregate state. Historical content never implies current applicability.

expected_revision.description: Current target knowledge aggregate_revision, not candidate or content revision.
